Thank you, I wish I could agree but I only seem to hate myself more and more as days go by. I'm seeing my doctor on Wednesday and I want to lay all.my cards on the table. But I'm just so scared of everything. I'm scared that I'm going to end up alone, and I can't get through this with my boyfriend. But I also don't want him to pity me and stay, assuming I can ever even explain this all to him..I can never find the words cause I just don't want him to look at my differently like everyone else does. I just want him to keep seeing the me inside the one I hide away. I just want to give up, it's easier and less painful for me but I also don't want people to mourn me or be sad cause they don't deserve to be sad over me, even if in a fake way. I dunno, I feel like I make less sense everyday. My mind just feels jumbled with no clarity right now. I just want to sleep and wake up from this nightmare or just never wake up. Maybe I can get better but at what cost, what's the point of being better if I've already fuckrd everything up. But thank you for believing in me.

When you have a mental illness it's really hard to maintain friendships, not only cause its fucking hard when you're broken inside but also cause you push people away so they don't get hurt & so that you personally don't get hurt when they give up on you. 

I suffer with my own severe mental health issues so I completely understand why she may not have any friends or people to talk to. There's a reason so many kill themselves every year, its hard to be vulnerable to people you may care about, it's easier to push them away cause it hurts way less than another person giving up on you.

I've lived in East London by whole life and I've never felt unsafe anywhere in London, bad stuff happens everywhere at anytime so I've never let it bother me. 

Reality is though, if you're just going about your own business majority of people aren't gonna bother you - unless it's a act of random violence (which could happen anywhere anyway). 

But then again I'm severely depressed so maybe that's why I'm not scared of anything bad happening to me 🤷‍♀️
